## Full screen from the first second, and a desktop that moves

**Full screen, like F11**
- Windmill now opens full screen right away, and the Windows taskbar steps aside immediately instead of after the home screen loads.
- The taskbar's space goes to your apps too, so a maximized app fills the whole screen.
- Press **F11** to switch between full screen and a window with the taskbar. In Settings it's Windmill → Full screen.
- The taskbar always comes back when Windmill closes, even if something goes wrong.

**A new shell**
- One island at the top: both halves of the bar meet in the middle, larger, and lean in when your pointer comes close.
- The dock unfolds out of its button, and its apps pop in one after another. Push your pointer against the bottom edge and the dock comes to you, then leaves once you move away.
- Depth: when Settings, Search, the panel, All apps or the control center opens, the desktop steps back, blurs and dims, so only what you opened is in focus.
- Light drifts slowly across the wallpaper and follows your pointer. When Windmill starts, the desktop comes into focus.
- Running apps get a glowing dot.

**Sign in with GitHub works**
- Windmill now has its own GitHub app. Sign in with a one-time code: no password in Windmill, and your token stays on your PC. Sign out any time in Settings → Account.

**Fixed**
- Windows could keep showing an older Windmill after an update. Every file is now stamped with its version.

**Updating on Android:** uninstall the older Windmill first, then install 0.4.
